title: Viewport feedback color degradation
body: ### Tested versions 4.0, 4.1, 4.4 beta 4 ### System information Godot v4.4.beta4 - macOS Sequoia (15.3.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M2 - Apple M2 (8 threads) ### Issue description Two SubViewports nested in a feedback loop do not preserve the original color. Specifically, when the Viewports employ 3D rendering and the project is on the Compatibility renderer. It most likely means that all 3D rendering is ever so slightly off color. Here's a video. Note the color ramp moving downward to show the degradation over time. Interesting how it remains monochrome - each RGB value is affected equally https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0adab120-8eb0-496f-bc4a-a9760c887c17 What it should look like. Captured on Forward+ I have a custom Node called [Feedback](https://github.com/celyk/godot-useful-stuff/blob/main/scripts/Feedback.gd) that exhibits the problem, as it is just 2 Viewports under the hood. I have been using Feedback on iOS with limited success, but the color shifting is very annoying and destroys certain effects. So far I've tested it on MacOS and Linux Mint, and on a range of Godot 4 versions. The problem appears consistently ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a 2D scene 2. Add a [Feedback](https://github.com/celyk/godot-useful-stuff/blob/main/scripts/Feedback.gd) 3. Add a TextureRect 4. Assign the TextureRect a ViewportTexture pointing to Feedback 4. Observe colors. Image may move around but colors should not change 5. Switch to the Compatibility renderer 6. Colors will change ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [feedback-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18906470/feedback-test.zip)
